title: Hormuz Mein 14 Tanker vs US Navy: Bharat Ka Tel Bill Kitna? #Shorts
description:
Iran ke Kharg Island par 14 tel ke tanker taiyaar khade hain aur saamne US Navy ki naakebandi. Ladaai Iran aur America ki hai, par April-October mein Bharat ka crude bill Rs 10.49 lakh crore pahunch gaya: pichhle poore saal ka 94%, jabki tel sirf 2.7% zyada khareeda.

Status 24 November 2026 subah tak: convoy ne naakebandi paar nahi ki hai. 14 tanker wala daawa Iran ke saansad Vahid Ahmadi ka hai; Iran ne convoy ka official elaan nahi kiya.
